title: Insufficient information
text: Insufficient information. Well I guess it will be OK.  It's very attractive right out of the box, but there is zero information in the box about how to use the poacher (oven - max temperature, stove top-max flame, etc.),or how to clean and maintain it (which you can at least find on the Berghoff website).  Also, many companies enclose examples of appropriate  recipes and other uses of their products, but no such information came with this product.  It would have been nice for non-cooks like myself.  Though I imagine people who cook a lot will be fine, I'm hunting high and low for the next step after removing it from the box.  Instructions would have been helpful.
